v2.0.1 Update
🎬 Scene-Specific Automation: Limit scene presets to one or more Foundry scenes for combat start and combat end automation. Matching scoped presets take priority for that trigger, while scenes without a match keep using unrestricted presets.

🔤 Main Text Case: Enable Preserve Main Text Case per preset to keep the capitalization you typed in preview and playback. Existing presets remain uppercase unless the option is enabled.

✨ Movable Cinematic Effects: Move Cinematic Effects horizontally or vertically and adjust their scale in personal cut-ins and All-Out Attacks. The controls update live previews and playback, while existing presets keep their current appearance by default.

announcement.title: 🎬 Cinematic Cut-ins v2.0.1
announcement.content:
v2.0.1: Scene Automation, Text Case & Effect Controls

  • Limit combat start and combat end scene presets to one or more Foundry scenes. Matching scoped presets take priority for that trigger; other scenes keep using unrestricted presets.
  • Enable Preserve Main Text Case per preset to keep typed capitalization in preview and playback. Existing presets remain uppercase until enabled.
  • Move Cinematic Effects horizontally or vertically and adjust their scale in personal cut-ins and All-Out Attacks. Changes appear in live previews and playback, and existing presets keep their current appearance by default.
